unknown: No compatible clinical source label. Different or mixed territory, non-MI disease, missing condition or contradictory fields are not controls.
groups: Publisher patient folders; retain every RECORDS ECG and report per-patient supports. Detect differing within-patient known states and keep them visible.
eligibility_gate: At least five unambiguous positive patients and five explicit control patients in the released cohort for an endpoint-specific comparison.
execution: Stage 1 provider-checksummed headers only, no scores or fitting. Stage 2 if supported: all 549 RECORDS rows eligible, untouched P4 at its published operating points and V3AG auxiliary ranks where no published threshold exists. Compare explicit compatible clinical territory vs healthy control; no category relabeling.
restrictions: Clinical source descriptors are distinct from an independent contemporaneous ECG adjudication; enriched comparator, not natural-prevalence predictive values. No pooling with LUDB or SPH. Different from PTB-XL; overlap cannot be certified from provider name, namespace or raw binary digests.
